name: Tappoo
verdict: Tappoo is part of the Tappoos Group of Companies — a family-owned Fijian company. Nothing found.
note: Shorts sponsor of the FIJI Water Flying Fijians under the four-year agreement announced by the Fiji Rugby Union on 6 February 2025, which also makes Tappoo the union's official distribution partner. No state or fund in the ownership chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding found.
